# Upstream Digital

> Upstream Digital is a digital marketing agency in Greenwich, Connecticut. It offers paid advertising on Meta, Google and LinkedIn, search engine optimization (SEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO), website design and development, content creation, and digital marketing consulting. It recommends only the services a client actually needs, stays hands-on after launch, gives clients direct access to the team, and works month to month with no long-term lock-in.

Contact: info@getupstreamdigital.com, +1 (860) 450-6983. Based in Greenwich, CT 06830; works with businesses across Connecticut, New York and the US.

## Services

- [Paid Advertising](https://www.getupstreamdigital.com/services/paid-advertising/): Meta, Google and LinkedIn ad campaigns built to generate qualified leads.
- [SEO & AEO](https://www.getupstreamdigital.com/services/seo-aeo/): rank higher on Google and show up in answers from AI assistants; local SEO, Google Business Profile, content strategy.
- [Website Design & Development](https://www.getupstreamdigital.com/services/website-design-development/): fast, easy to navigate websites built to turn visitors into customers.
- [Content Creation](https://www.getupstreamdigital.com/services/content-creation/): ad creative, website copy and SEO content.
- [Digital Marketing Consulting](https://www.getupstreamdigital.com/services/digital-marketing-consulting/): honest feedback and a clear strategy for growth.

## Case studies

- [Phibro RenewOil](https://www.getupstreamdigital.com/case-studies/phibro-renewoil/): used cooking oil collection in CT, NY and NJ. Meta Ads, Google Ads, web design, SEO/AEO. Went from relying on paid ads to getting most of their new business online, through ads, a new website and local SEO. 36% lead conversion rate on a top campaign.
- [Spade Security](https://www.getupstreamdigital.com/case-studies/spade-security/): turnstile and access control installer. Google Ads, web design, SEO/AEO. 96% decrease in cost per qualified lead within two months, more qualified leads in two months than the previous agency delivered the year before, and 25% decrease in ad spend.
- [Olson Floor Supply](https://www.getupstreamdigital.com/case-studies/olson-floor-supply/): hardwood flooring, supplies and Benjamin Moore paint in New York. Website built from scratch, 32 local landing pages, ongoing SEO.
- [Honorary Consulate of Italy in Connecticut](https://www.getupstreamdigital.com/case-studies/italian-consulate-connecticut/): new website and local SEO. Ranks #1 on Google with 100+ Google reviews.
